hosting: romUrl values are same-repo relative paths (relative to classic/gba/index.html); remote URLs can be dropped in later with no code changes.

games.title: FLAPPY BIRD GBA
games.desc: A full Flappy Bird clone written for the Game Boy Advance by tullrich as a GBA dev exercise. Tap-friendly, runs great on mGBA in the browser.

games.title: STNICCC 2000 GBA PORT
games.desc: Game Boy Advance port of the classic Atari ST demo STNICCC 2000 by Oxygene, ported by GValiente. A 60fps palette-cycling demo party piece.

games.title: GOOGLE DINO ADVANCE
games.desc: The Chrome offline dino runner, rebuilt for the GBA by Ethan Fritz (fritzem). Full arcade mode with jumping, crouching and day/night cycles.

games.title: PIUGBA
games.desc: Pump It Up arcade simulator for the GBA by Rodrigo Alfonso (afska) — step to music with pad charts, a mini rhythm-game in your pocket.

games.title: GEMATRIX
games.desc: Gem-matching puzzle game for the GBA by Issung, a GBAJam 2024 entry built with the Butano engine. Match gems, chain combos, beat your score.

games.title: CASCADE7
games.desc: A Drop7-inspired open-source puzzle game for the GBA by Mick Schroeder. Discs fall into columns — clear them when their count matches the row length.

games.title: FLAPPY BIRD ADVANCE
games.desc: Another port of Flappy Bird to the GBA by johedan20012, built with the Butano engine. Ships its full license bundle (Butano, devkitARM, asset licenses) with the ROM.

games.title: DUSTLINE
games.desc: Original GBA driving-and-combat RPG prototype by abhuva, built with Butano. Cruise a wasteland, fight scavengers — an ambitious open 2MB cart.
